title: Extra: adding and subtracting on the abacus
summary: Add and subtract 2-digit numbers by moving beads on an {{term:abacus}}. Exchange ten ones beads for one tens bead, and back.
guide: This is an extra studio. In Afghanistan, children in grade 2 add and subtract on the "chot", a simple {{term:abacus}}.
The right rod is the ones, the left rod is the tens. Each bead on the tens rod is worth 10.
If the ones rod has 10 beads or more, press ← 10: ten beads come off and one bead goes on the tens rod.
If there aren't enough ones beads, press 1 →: one tens bead comes off and ten beads go on the ones rod.

add-exchange.prompt: The abacus shows 15. Add 8. Guess: what will it be?
add-exchange.hint: Put 8 beads on the ones. That makes 13 ones. Then press ← 10.
add-exchange.success: Well done! 15 + 8 = 23. Ten ones became one ten.
add-exchange.why: Why can't the 13 beads stay on the ones rod?
add-exchange.model: Only one digit fits in each place. Ten ones beads are the same as one tens bead. So 13 ones are 1 ten and 3 ones.

feedback.needs-exchange: There are 10 or more beads on the ones. Press ← 10.
feedback.on-tens: You put the beads on the tens: that's 80! We want 8 ones.
feedback.lost-one: One bead is missing. Count again.
feedback.too-small: Not enough yet. Put 8 beads on the ones.
feedback.empty: You took them all off. Make 15 again.

add-two-digit.hint: 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones. Put 1 bead on the tens and 3 on the ones. Then exchange ten ones.
add-two-digit.why: The ones were 8 and 3. Why is the answer 41 and not 31?
add-two-digit.model: 8 + 3 = 11 ones. Ten of them became one ten, and 1 one is left. 2 tens, 1 ten and that new ten make 4 tens. So 41.

feedback.forgot-tens: You put on the ones, but forgot the 1 ten in 13.
feedback.forgot-ones: You put on the ten. Now put on the 3 ones too.
feedback.needs-exchange: There are 10 or more beads on the ones. Press ← 10.

sub-beads.hint: 12 is 1 ten and 2 ones. Take 2 beads off the ones and 1 bead off the tens.
sub-beads.why: Why did you take only 1 bead off the tens, not 10?
sub-beads.model: Each tens bead is worth 10 on its own. 1 tens bead is 10.

feedback.added: You put beads on. This time take them off.
feedback.forgot-ones: You took the ten. Now take 2 ones too.
feedback.forgot-tens: You took the ones. Take 1 bead off the tens too.
feedback.empty: You took them all off! Make 25 again.

sub-exchange.prompt: The abacus shows 42. Take away 17. There are only 2 beads on the ones! What can you do?
sub-exchange.hint: Press 1 →. One tens bead becomes ten ones beads. Now you have 12 ones. Take 7. Then take 1 bead off the tens.
sub-exchange.why: Reza said, "7 − 2 = 5, so the answer is 35." What went wrong?
sub-exchange.model: We need to take 7 ones from 2 ones, not the other way round. 2 ones aren't enough, so we break a ten: 12 − 7 = 5 ones. 3 tens are left, and we take 1 ten: 2 tens. The answer is 25.

feedback.smaller-from-larger: Did you take 2 from 7, like Reza? You must take 7 ones from the ones. First break a ten with 1 →.
feedback.only-tens: You took 1 ten. Take 7 ones too.
feedback.only-two: You took 2 ones. Where are the other 5? Break a ten.
feedback.needs-exchange: There are 10 or more beads on the ones. Press ← 10.
feedback.empty: You took them all off! Make 42 again.
